title: Challenge: your first containers
intro: Time to drive Docker: run a container, see it, peek inside, and clean up. (Commands are checked, not actually executed, so you can practice safely.)

steps.instruction: Run an nginx container in the background (detached). Naming it 'web' will help later.
steps.success:
Unable to find image 'nginx:latest' locally
latest: Pulling from library/nginx
Status: Downloaded newer image for nginx:latest
7f3a9c1b2d3e4f...
steps.fail: Use docker run with -d (detached) and the nginx image. Add --name web to name it.

steps.instruction: List the running containers to confirm it's up.
steps.success:
CONTAINER ID   IMAGE   STATUS         NAMES
7f3a9c1b2d3e   nginx   Up 3 seconds   web

steps.instruction: Open an interactive shell INSIDE the 'web' container.
steps.success: root@7f3a9c1b2d3e:/#   (you're inside the container now, type 'exit' to leave)
steps.fail: Use docker exec with -it to get an interactive shell in 'web'.

steps.instruction: Stop the container when you're done.
Finally, remove the stopped container to clean up.

done: Solved! run → ps → exec → stop → rm is the daily-driver loop. Everything else in Docker builds on these.
